metadata.summary: Jitin ordered a Classic Nova Lox Sandwich on a Blueberry bagel with a Tropicana Apple Juice.

messages.text: Hello Jitin Welcome to manhattan bagel It is great to see you again What would you like to order?
Yeah. But I want to order, like, one Tropicana apple juice and one classic, sorry. Yeah. Classic bagel.

That would be our Classic Nova Lox Sandwich on the menu, and a Tropicana Orange Juice. I'll add those for you. For your Classic Nova Lox Sandwich, you can choose a bagel. I have Plain, Everything, Blueberry, or Cinnamon Raisin. Want to hear more options?
No. Please add the blue variable.
For your Classic Nova Lox Sandwich, I've got the Blueberry bagel. Now, would you like your sandwich toasted, lightly toasted, toasted dark, or no toast?
So, toasted dark for your Classic Nova Lox Sandwich on a Blueberry bagel. Now, would you like to add any extra lox to your sandwich?
I've got that noted. No extra lox. For your side, you can choose from Chips or Cole Slaw. Which one would you like?
Nothing. Just, just complete my order. I may add one apple juice topping on apple flavor. Yes. Hello? Hello? Are you there?
